gaps.text: The deterministic core does not build a forward schedule of R&D, pilot-line, commercialization, or financing cash needs.

gaps.text: Assess whether the latest reduction in operating cash use is durable through the next technical and commercialization milestones.

gaps.text: Verify unrestricted liquidity, marketable-security maturities, contractual milestone receipts, commitments, and financing alternatives before using the cash observation.
gaps.text_zh: 使用现金观察前，需核验非受限流动性、有价证券期限、合同里程碑回款、承诺事项与融资替代方案。
